data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to use platform APIs for package:cryptography_plus
data.what_it_does: Enables package:cryptography_plus to use native platform APIs in Android, iOS, and Mac OS X for cryptographic operations. Falls back to pure Dart or background isolates when platform APIs are unavailable.
use_when: You need better performance for cryptographic algorithms like AES-GCM or ChaCha20 in your Flutter app.
You want to leverage secure operating system crypto APIs on Android, iOS, and macOS.
avoid_when: You do not use package:cryptography_plus in your project.
Your target platforms are exclusively ones without native platform crypto adapters provided by this package.
strengths: Up to 100 times better performance compared to pure Dart implementations.
Automatic fallback to Dart implementations when operating system APIs cannot be used.
Uses background isolates for lengthy computations to keep the UI smooth.
weaknesses: Platform API availability varies by algorithm and operating system (e.g., some algorithms are only supported on Apple operating systems or Android).
Requires managing specific package dependencies like cryptography_plus.
data.setup_notes: Add cryptography_plus and cryptography_flutter to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.
